activities.description: Give a cigarette to the man with long brown hair and sunglasses and he tries a trick. Seen at night at the outdoor bar.

activities.name: Stolen Tiger in Van
activities.description: Two men with a stuck van. Open the van to find a stolen tiger.

activities.name: Safe - Fleeca Bank (Key Lento)
activities.description: Safe inside the Fleeca bank. Code: 1747.

activities.name: Grenade Launcher
activities.description: Grenade launcher pickup in the alley behind the shops.

activities.name: Shrewsbury SM69 Sniper Rifle
activities.description: On the roof of the tower in Ambrosia, next to the Immigrantasma (Blue) card.

activities.name: Hunter Shoots His Friend
activities.description: You hear gunshots and find two hunters: one shot his friend, mistaking him for a deer. Get both into your vehicle and drive them to the nearest hospital before the wounded hunter gets worse.

activities.name: Mandy Filming Her Neighbor
activities.description: Meet Mandy in front of a yellow house, next to a small blue cottage. She is secretly filming her naked neighbor.

activities.name: Scorpio Nipper .38
activities.description: Compact pistol on the roof of the 247 store in Key Lento.

activities.name: Safe - Vanessa
activities.description: Enter the safe code found on Vanessa's laptop here.

activities.name: Brofile Pic
activities.description: Three guys drinking on top of the Wonder Whale ask you to take a picture of them.

activities.name: Skunk Ape Effigy
activities.description: One of the three skunk ape effigies.

activities.name: Skunk Ape Effigy
activities.description: One of the three skunk ape effigies.

activities.name: Robbed at the ATM
activities.description: A man in a floral shirt pulls a gun as you start a deposit and demands all your cash. Hand it over, or refuse and he tries to kill you.

activities.name: Skunk Ape Effigy
activities.description: One of the three skunk ape effigies.

activities.name: Drunk Man at the Rusty Anchor
activities.description: A drunk man stumbles outside the Rusty Anchor asking for cash. Give him money for a ride home, or watch him water the plants and drive off drunk in his boat.

activities.name: Gellhorn Hunting Spot
activities.description: A hunting magazine marks this as a good spot for wild boars, wild white turkeys, Leonida panthers and black foxes. Recommended weapon: Shrewsbury SM-69 rifle.

activities.name: Duke 556 Assault Rifle
activities.description: Near the seaplane, on top of the small building to the right of the water tank (facing the water).

activities.name: Dumpster Diver
activities.description: During Chapter 2, a dumpster diver at the motel where Jason and Lucia are staying.

activities.name: A Couple's Dream
activities.description: A couple near the motel's reception entrance, dreaming about their future.

activities.name: Payday Loan Crashout
activities.description: Inside Cash Flow Loans on Gellhorn Avenue, Port Gellhorn: a bald man rages at the ATM and cracks its screen.

activities.name: Iguana Target Practice
activities.description: Three "ecologists" are shooting pumpkins. They challenge you to a $250 contest: shoot the most iguanas after they release them from a cage.

activities.name: Bat Batesaurio
activities.description: Unique bat. Pick it up next to the red mesh cage near Dino Golf.

activities.name: 556 Shortcut
activities.description: Assault rifle pickup.

activities.name: Alien Encounter
activities.description: A car sits on the road with all doors open, headlights flashing and a glitching radio. Further along, a bright light in a field: a naked middle-aged woman being beamed up by a tractor beam.

activities.name: Mudslider Mechanic
activities.description: A mechanic fixing his car for the mudslide race asks you to sit in the driver's seat and rev the engine a few times until it is fixed.

activities.name: Redneck W-22
activities.description: Inside the derailed train.

activities.name: Safe - VR Gamer House
activities.description: In the house, next to the bedroom.

activities.name: Fox Furry Cornered by Police
activities.description: A man in a fox costume cornered by the police.

activities.name: Machete
activities.description: On top of the hay bales.

activities.name: Cockroach Xtreme 556 Assault Rifle
activities.description: Unique weapon at the back of the garage.

activities.name: Swamp Meditation
activities.description: On the wooden dock by the lookout tower in the middle of Buckskin Swamp. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia (2 of the 18 meditations). A boat or airboat is the easiest way to get there.

activities.name: Plane Crash (highway)
activities.description: Driving on the highway you see a small plane trailing black smoke. Follow it to where it crashes on the nearby hill.

activities.name: UFO Believer (Human Sibling)
activities.description: A man standing on the hood of his pickup talks to you about UFOs. May only appear after the nearby UFO encounter.

activities.name: Safe - Wash House
activities.description: The code is right under the collectible card.

activities.name: Influencer Livestreaming on Bridge
activities.description: A man on the bridge is livestreaming.

activities.name: Drug Mule KZ-59
activities.description: Underwater. Look for floating debris and dive straight down to the sunken boat. The weapon is under the boat.

activities.name: Undercover Cop Torture
activities.description: In this warehouse two men are torturing a tied-up plain-clothes police officer. Listen in, or kill them and untie the cop.

activities.name: Polar Bear Activists
activities.description: Activists trying to free polar bears.

activities.name: Car Accident
activities.description: A car crash with a bag you can steal.

activities.name: Stash Bust
activities.description: Cops have seized $1,200 of product. Kill them to take the bag and sell it at Dunks.

activities.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
activities.description: A vehicle stuck by the water, the driver asks for help. Open the back door: a tiger jumps out and eats him.

activities.name: The Ritual of Sacrifice
activities.description: Inside the building there is an icon: bring a human corpse to it to start a mini-quest.

activities.name: Shirley, the Neighbor
activities.description: Shirley offers two side jobs during the chapter: bring her a bottle of rum, and steal her friend's scooter. In return you may use her car.

activities.name: Rocket Launcher
activities.description: At the shipwreck in the Featherstone Islands: in one of the crates on the beach.

activities.name: Jason's House Meditation
activities.description: Chapter 1 only (missable): after a morning talk in the kitchen, follow Lucia to the balcony with the training equipment and accept her offer to meditate. Counts as 1 of the 18 meditations.

activities.name: Smooth Sand Meditation
activities.description: On a small sandbar off the west coast of Capri, north of Belpoint. Swim or take a boat. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

activities.name: Worn Stone Meditation
activities.description: At the water's edge of the Emerald River at Camp Moonflower. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

activities.name: Red Rocks Meditation
activities.description: In Manifest Canyon, near where the railway crosses the highway. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

activities.name: Water Wheel Meditation
activities.description: By the old water wheel on the river, next to the ruins of the Lawton Co. Paper Mill in south Moreau. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

activities.name: Jutting Cliff Meditation
activities.description: In Mount Kalaga National Park, on a cliff by a tower overlooking a mine, north of Kalaga Reservoir. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

activities.name: Waterfall Meditation
activities.description: Northwest of Tallaloko, on a river overlooking a waterfall. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

activities.name: Seaside Meditation
activities.description: On a rocky outcrop on the beach east of Waning Sands. Meditate once as Jason and once as Lucia.

activities.name: Ascent Meditation
activities.description: The final meditation, in the stone circle at the summit of Mount Kalaga. It only appears on the map after you have done all the other meditations, and needs both Jason and Lucia.

activities.name: Frag Grenades
activities.description: Under the overpass, near a bright construction light and shovels: break open the large wooden crate for 3 or more frag grenades.

activities.name: Merman Encounter
activities.description: A man in a mermaid tail lies on the beach, livestreaming. He allows at least 2 selfies; take more for a surprise.

activities.name: Skunk Ape Effigy
activities.description: A tribal statue made of wood and plants, painted in bright colors.

activities.name: Safe - Stormy
activities.description: Safe code: 7869.

activities.name: Wounded Hunter
activities.description: A hunter has been shot and needs to be taken to hospital.

activities.name: Sticky Bombs
activities.description: In a crate inside the warehouse.

activities.name: Sticky Bombs
activities.description: In the crate.

activities.name: AT-T
activities.description: On a crate in the fence's yard.

activities.name: Frag Grenades
activities.description: Under the bridge in a large wooden crate, just behind a large construction light with shovels and cones.

activities.name: Junkie Car Theft
activities.description: A junkie asks you to help her steal a car.

activities.name: Warehouse Hostage
activities.description: Two men are holding a man hostage in the warehouse.

activities.name: Stranded Race Driver
activities.description: A race driver has broken down on the side of the road and asks for a ride to a race before it's too late.

activities.name: Store Hostage Rescue
activities.description: A vehicle with an open trunk and a trail of blood leading into the building, where M7 are beating and torturing the manager.

activities.name: Farm Wife Asking for Help
activities.description: A woman in a robe with a flashlight asks you to help her husband, who has had an accident, in their house.

activities.name: Sticky Bombs
activities.description: Inside the last open train car, in a wooden box.

activities.name: Gun Nut House: SM-01
activities.description: Break into the house through the side door: the gun is on the kitchen counter with plenty of ammo next to it, and there's body armor in the bedroom.

activities.name: Car Accident (truck crash)
activities.description: A Sahara Mirage truck crashes into a car. The driver asks you to lie for him and promises you money if he gets a settlement.

activities.name: Tutsi the Cow
activities.description: Catch Tutsi the cow.

activities.name: Safe - Drug Warehouse
activities.description: In the office of the warehouse where a gunfight left everyone dead. Lots to take: guns, a rare card, cocaine and cash.

activities.name: Captive Ex-Cop
activities.description: Free the captured ex-cop.

activities.name: Scraper VF5C
activities.description: On the top floor, near the safe.

activities.name: Parachute (Effluvia roof)
activities.description: Parachute box on the Effluvia rooftop.

activities.name: Beefslap
activities.description: A man is standing on top of his broken-down car.

activities.name: Yard Sale (Gary the alligator)
activities.description: A lady holds a yard sale with an alligator named Gary.

activities.name: Being Hunted
activities.description: You get tranquilized and wake up in a storage container, where you have to fight for your life.

activities.name: Safe - Room 115
activities.description: Safe code: 4242.

activities.name: Hotspot - Atlantic Spadefish
activities.description: Part of Cal's fishing quest.

activities.name: Cop Interrogated by Criminals
activities.description: Criminals are interrogating a cop.

activities.name: Molotov Cocktails
activities.description: In a chest full of Molotovs.

activities.name: Safe (abandoned house)
activities.description: Climb onto the abandoned house and go through the hole in the roof.

activities.name: Safe (shipwreck)
activities.description: Inside the wrecked ship.

activities.name: Burning Car Collision
activities.description: Two cars have collided and one is burning. The black pickup has a large chest in its bed with cocaine, cash and a Zhang Wu Type 9.

activities.name: Kitty Litter Drug Ring
activities.description: A woman produces Kitty Litter, a synthetic drug. If you pass through, you have to wait until the police finish their operation.

activities.name: Molotov Cocktails
activities.description: Break open the crate at the end of the destroyed building, behind the drug deal gone wrong.

activities.name: AI Ex-CEO
activities.description: May only appear at night.

activities.name: Ghost Woman
activities.description: Drive here at night: your car shuts off and a ghost woman crawls towards you, then appears in your car or as you get out.

activities.name: Ghost Ship (lighthouse)
activities.description: Go to the lighthouse at night: you hear voices and see ghosts that leave clues to a cursed knife in the ocean. With the knife, climb to the top of the lighthouse and face the ocean: the ghost ship appears.

activities.name: Black Eagle Import Kalinga .50
activities.description: In the safe. Door code: 789987, safe code: 031462.

activities.name: Bridge Jumpers
activities.description: A couple of kids jump off the bridge. Challenge them and choose to jump together, and there is more to this encounter.

activities.name: Drunk Tractor Driver
activities.description: A drunk man asks you to help him drive his tractor.

activities.name: Carjacker at Gunpoint
activities.description: A stranger gets into your car, holds a gun to your head and makes you drive.

activities.name: Gasoline Bath
activities.description: A man is filling his bathtub with gasoline.

activities.name: Gang Revenge
activities.description: Witness a drive-by shooting: gang retaliation in which a rival member (an M7 recruit) is killed.

activities.name: Hillinger Boomer
activities.description: In a crate you can break open.

activities.name: Convict Kalinga .50
activities.description: Enter at the Escaped Prisoners barn: underground, at the end of the collapsed tunnel, by the dead prisoner.

activities.name: Insurance Fraud
activities.description: After an accident, a man in a burning car: help him and it turns into insurance fraud.

activities.name: Bear Protesters (animal transport)
activities.description: Protesters block a truck carrying a live bear.

activities.name: Crop Dusting Job (McKittrick Farm)
activities.description: A job posting at the Starlet Motel says to call Kyle at McKittrick Farm: he has a crop dusting job.

activities.name: Taser Arrest
activities.description: A man climbs onto a police car, gets tasered and is arrested.

activities.name: Anti-Theft Car
activities.description: Steal the car and its anti-theft system takes over: it locks the doors and windows and drives you to the police station.

activities.name: Gang Trade
activities.description: Only at night: two gangs meet to trade goods. Ambush them and take the loot (around $1,500).

activities.name: Drunk Man on a Police Car
activities.description: A drunk man dances on a police car while officers try to handle him.

activities.name: Paranoid Prepper's Bunker
activities.description: Move the container to reach the bunker, and watch out for mines: a paranoid man sets you more challenges for money.

activities.name: Roadside Forest Fire
activities.description: Off the left side of the highway, a patch of trees is on fire.

activities.name: Clumsy Car Thief
activities.description: A clumsy woman needs your help stealing a car.

activities.name: Botched Robbery
activities.description: Robbers flee the payday loan store, dropping wads of cash on the tarmac as the owner chases them; the cash is left scattered around.

activities.name: Attempted Carjacking
activities.description: At night a muscle car blocks the road and its driver demands money.

activities.name: Kolt & Associates Highway Ambush
activities.description: After completing the chapter 2 mission "Slam Dunk" and gain the ability to raid their drug operations you'll be able to unlock this random encounter as they try to retaliate via an ambush. They will run the car off the road and try to kill you.

activities.name: Former Final Chapter Member Attacked
activities.description: A former Final Chapter member is being beaten and threatened. Help him and untie him to complete it.

activities.name: Newlyweds' House
activities.description: Listen in on a couple who have just got married.

activities.name: Kidnapped Cop
activities.description: Two people have tied up a police officer.

activities.name: Dirty Cops (hangar)
activities.description: Inside the hangar at 3 a.m.: a cop tied to a chair is beaten up by two dirty cops.

activities.name: Lady with a Couch
activities.description: Help the woman with her couch and you get kidnapped into the game's take on the Saw movies.

activities.name: Influencer Falls from Overpass
activities.description: A streamer livestreaming on the edge of the bridge accidentally falls off.

activities.name: Drug Export Threat
activities.description: Two men are threatening another man. Question them and they tell you to back off; talk more with the threatened man.

activities.name: Traffic Stop: Golf Clubs
activities.description: A woman is pulled over and her car searched; the police only find golf clubs.

activities.name: Corrupt Cops Rob a Dealer
activities.description: Two corrupt cops beat a drug dealer and steal his cocaine, which opens a possible robbery.

activities.name: Loose Pet Tiger
activities.description: Kingfishers gang members are mauled by a loose tiger. Shoot it, then fight the gang members who arrive.

activities.name: Linda's Coupon Meltdown
activities.description: Linda, the motel receptionist, tries to get a restaurant coupon accepted, is refused and blows up at the staff.

activities.name: Man Tied Up in a Barn
activities.description: A man yells for help, guarded by two thugs. After you save him, there is a shotgun in the back of their truck.

activities.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
activities.description: Help push the stuck van (reward: adrenaline).

activities.name: Swamp Bait Akulus
activities.description: Revolver. On the floor of a wrecked cabin in the middle of the Pelican Valley swamp.

activities.name: Rocket Launcher
activities.description: Contents may vary: a member found a shotgun in it.

activities.name: Non-Flusher Movement QR Code
activities.description: Scan the QR code with WAiNK and answer the Non-Flusher Movement message: it unlocks the side mission to meet a contact at Frank's Waffles in Tequesta, Vice-Dale County.

activities.name: Chromium W-10
activities.description: Unique weapon, inside the house in the gaming room.

activities.name: Sticky Bombs
activities.description: Crate with 3 sticky bombs.

activities.name: Spangled Vatra
activities.description: Unique weapon, for sale only at this Ammu-Nation.

activities.name: Creepy Neighbour Zach
activities.description: Zach is poking a dead animal with a tree branch; call him out and see what happens.

activities.name: Guardia Brothers VF5
activities.description: Unique weapon, on the coffee table on the second floor of the warehouse.

activities.name: Laird 350 Sniper Rifle
activities.description: Up top, by the card.

activities.name: ATV Rally
activities.description: A crowd watches ATVs jump one of the stunt jumps, and you are invited to take part: a guy challenges you to jump over the concession building for $500.

activities.name: Safe (slum house)
activities.description: Code: 9790.

activities.name: Car Jacking Lesson
activities.description: Help a woman break into a locked car and steal it.

activities.name: Overpass Vandals (computers)
activities.description: Three rednecks throw computers at cars from the highway overpass. You can scare them off.

activities.name: Delirious Farmer
activities.description: A farmer driving his tractor in circles.

activities.name: Overpass Droppings
activities.description: Three people throw tyres and junk off the overpass. Confront them and they back off quickly.

activities.name: Drive-Through Rant (Pollo Diablo)
activities.description: A woman ranting about cheese at the drive-through window.

activities.name: Kolt & Associates Vatra
activities.description: Unique SMG very close to the door.

activities.name: La Polilla Negra KZ-59
activities.description: On a weapon case, close to the safe.

activities.name: Zodiac Nipper .38
activities.description: In the garage of the robbery opportunity.

activities.name: Caveman vs Panther
activities.description: After the caveman deals with a panther, he challenges you to a race.

activities.name: Money Bag & Deadringer 1922 Pistols
activities.description: Two unique 1922 pistols inside the caravan.

activities.name: Safe (caravan)
activities.description: Inside the caravan with the unique pistols: cash and a collectible card.

activities.name: Man vs Bear
activities.description: Tell the man to scare the bear off and he survives and promises to send you money.

activities.name: Sal, Shooting Victim
activities.description: Sal was shot by people trying to rob his wallet. He needs a ride and help with something.

activities.name: Package Delivery
activities.description: Deliver 3 packages for a broken-down Sahara driver.

activities.name: Alien Aficionado
activities.description: A man waiting to see something: keep the conversation going.

activities.name: Lady with a Broken Car
activities.description: A woman with a damaged car refuses help and gets aggressive. There is a stash in the trunk.

activities.name: Safe (gaming room)
activities.description: In the gaming room of the house.

activities.name: Martha's 1922 Pistol
activities.description: Go into the house and search the oven.

activities.name: Flare Gun
activities.description: Inside a metal box.

activities.name: Exotic Animals Front: Hidden Stash
activities.description: Listen to the parrot when it tells you to check the generator: right behind it there's an air shaft in the wall.

activities.name: Double Cross Vatra (Heavy SMG)
activities.description: On the sea floor, right under the Cocaine Yacht.

activities.name: Dumpster Man
activities.description: An attorney asks for pills. If you give him pills, he gives you legal advice.

activities.name: Kolt & Associates 556
activities.description: Unique AR: in a weapon case beside the safe in the right dorm.

activities.name: Cargo H&L .38
activities.description: Unique revolver in a SCOOP crate, alongside a few bricks of cocaine.

activities.name: Influencer (antenna)
activities.description: At the top of the antenna, an influencer girl takes photos.

activities.name: Grayson Hunting Spot
activities.description: A good place to find black bears and wild boars.

activities.name: Drug Boat Crash
activities.description: A drug boat drives in circles and blows up, dropping cocaine.

activities.name: Gasoline Bath
activities.description: A hillbilly fills a tub with gas in the bed of his truck, argues with the gas station clerk, then speeds off.

activities.name: Revenge on Kolt Associates
activities.description: Sal, who shot himself, asks you to get revenge on Booker at Kingpin Bowling.

activities.name: ADB M350 Longarm
activities.description: After killing Booker you can take this gun off his body.

activities.name: Kingfishers Akulus
activities.description: In a trailer.

activities.name: Animal Crackers - Grayson
activities.description: An Animal Crackers race, starting next to the Farm Tour and Red Canyon Run races.

activities.name: Disgruntled Employee
activities.description: In Huck's Pump N Go you're recognised as one of the couple that robs stores all around Leonida.

activities.name: Paleo Bro
activities.description: A man who wants to fight a panther tries to assert his dominance over it.

activities.name: The Ghost of Rockledge Rd
activities.description: Driving down Rockledge Road at night, a ghostly figure runs across the road.

activities.name: Influencing Gone Fatal
activities.description: Two rednecks film Jason or Lucia making fun of you; when you confront them they pull out their guns.

activities.name: Mistaken Identity ($2,000)
activities.description: A man mistakes you for someone else and asks you for $2,000.

activities.name: Parachute
activities.description: On top of the tower.

activities.name: Polar Bear Protest (freeway)
activities.description: A group of activists protest on the freeway for the release of a polar bear.

activities.name: Hobo Shotgun (for sale)
activities.description: A unique weapon you can buy from this store.

activities.name: Couch Trap
activities.description: Help a woman with a couch, get knocked out and wake up in a shipping container on an island.

activities.name: Zeke Pimple: Target Practice
activities.description: Two dudes want to challenge your shooting skills.

activities.name: Boar Rams a Man
activities.description: A boar runs out of the forest and rams a man.

activities.name: Moreau Hunting Spot
activities.description: A good place to find black bears and black foxes.

activities.name: The San Fierro Tourist
activities.description: Near the entrance to a mineshaft, a tourist from San Fierro runs away, scared of being attacked.

activities.name: Toilet Talk
activities.description: Wyman talks with the plumber about the toilets.

activities.name: Dodos Rising
activities.description: Activists protest against animal abuse: a polar bear is locked in the truck.

activities.name: Small Weed Farm
activities.description: Knock out the man at the front and enter the room: a small weed farm, loot around $1,000.

activities.name: Overheard Conversation (chimney)
activities.description: At the back, under the chimney, you can hear a conversation from inside.

activities.name: Kingpin Heathen
activities.description: In the room with the two safes.

activities.name: Overheard Conversation (clinic)
activities.description: On the left side, in the clinic, by the elevator.

activities.name: Gang Car Crash
activities.description: Gangsters roll their car over and are then killed by the police. Pick up the loot bag afterwards.

activities.name: Turnt Nipper .38
activities.description: Shoot the glider down by aiming at its ropes.

activities.name: Explorer's Knife
activities.description: In the underwater cave: scuba gear can be picked up at the stairs.

activities.name: Mobility Scooter Robber
activities.description: A woman on a mobility scooter steals a tourist's wallet, then tries to mug you.

activities.name: Parachute
activities.description: A box of parachutes at the south-east end of the rooftop walkway.

activities.name: Insurance Fraud (van crash)
activities.description: A van crashes into a car. The man fakes an insurance claim and asks you to be his witness for a payout.

activities.name: Parachute
activities.description: A box of parachutes on the rooftop walkway, north side of the roof.

activities.name: Couch Potato Mustang .357
activities.description: In front of Dunk's trailer: shoot the rope holding the couch in the tree, then sit on it to find the revolver.

activities.name: Kingfisher Intimidation
activities.description: Camo Kingfisher pickup rolls up to harass and threaten random man in parking lot. Their mad that he blew them off and didnt show up, they say. After they leave I question the man who got harassed and he reveals a Kingfisher Robbery opportunity on an island 1.69m north of Ammu-Nation parking lot.

activities.name: Police Raid
activities.description: Three or four police cars and a riot squad raid the building.

activities.name: Mushroom Trip (stamina boost)
activities.description: Eat the mushrooms to enter a trance and run an obstacle course. Finishing it improves your stamina.

activities.name: Rescue the Girl from Dru Kol
activities.description: Get back in your car from going in the gas station to find her in the backseat. Drive her back to Gellhorn, raid the Kolt warehouse (4/5 enemies, suppressed weapon recommended) and then break the safe and collect the cash dotted around the warehouse. Take is about $6k.

activities.name: Assassination
activities.description: A man shoots his opponent and runs off.

activities.name: Parachute (Flash FM transmitter)
activities.description: At the top of the Flash FM radio transmitter.

activities.name: Wanted Posters (side mission)
activities.description: Two wanted posters next to the front entrance of the Xero Food Mart. Examine them to unlock a side mission.

activities.name: Bud the Alien Hunter
activities.description: Around 19:00 you hear "woo woo" shouts: Bud stands on top of his car, hoping to draw aliens and take a picture of them.

activities.name: Tigers in the Garages
activities.description: There is a tiger in each of the garages of this house.

activities.name: Drugged Robber
activities.description: A man on drugs holds up his friend at the convenience store.

activities.name: Safe (Prairie Court)
activities.description: Inside the house; it needs a code.

activities.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
activities.description: Push the van out of the mud.

activities.name: Van Stuck in the Mud
activities.description: Help push the van out of the mud.

activities.name: Molotov Cocktails & Hammer
activities.description: A Molotov crate in the parking bay for the delivery truck, with a hammer on top.

activities.name: Shotgun (Kingpin Bowling)
activities.description: In the case on the pool table.

activities.name: Caravan Fight
activities.description: Knock on the caravan door enough times and the man inside comes out to fight.

activities.name: Jumbo the Gator
